name: Dwarf - Common
languages: Common, Dwarven, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Gnomish, Goblin, Jotun, Orcish, Petran, Sakvroth

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Dwarves are a short, stocky people who are often stubborn, fierce, and devoted.

traits.name: Clan Dagger
traits.description: You get one clan dagger for free, as it was given to you at birth. Selling this clan dagger is a terrible taboo and earns you the disdain of other dwarves.

name: Elf - Common
languages: Common, Elven, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Draconic, Empyrean, Fey, Gnomish, Goblin, Kholo, Orcish

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Elves are a tall, long-lived people with a strong tradition of art and magic.

name: Gnome - Common
languages: Common, Fey, Gnomish, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Goblin, Jotun, Orcish

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Gnomes are short and hardy folk, with an unquenchable curiosity and eccentric habits.

name: Goblin - Common
languages: Common, Goblin, Gnomish, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Draconic, Dwarven, Gnomish, Halfling, Kholo, Orcish

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Goblins are a short, scrappy, energetic people who have spent millennia maligned and feared.

name: Halfling - Common
languages: Common, Halfling, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Dwarven, Elven, Gnomish, Goblin

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Halflings are a short, resilient people who exhibit remarkable curiosity and humor.

traits.name: Keen Eyes
traits.description: Your eyes are sharp, allowing you to make out small details about concealed or even invisible creatures that others might miss. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find hidden or undetected creatures within 30 feet of you. When you target an opponent that is concealed from you or hidden from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.

name: Human - Common
languages: Common, Additional languages equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages.

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Humans are diverse and adaptable people with wide potential and deep ambitions..

name: Leshy - Common
darkvision: Low-Light Vision, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Draconic, Elven, Gnomish, Goblin, Halfling, Sakvroth.

skinColour: a body that continually produces small fruits imbued with primal magic (fruit leshy).
body that is made from fungi that grows in the shade of caves and trees and they are at home in dark caverns and warrens (fungus leshy).
a large gourd for a skull (gourd).
a body that is made from foliage and leaves. They always fall gracefully (leaf leshy).
a body accented by lotus flower leaves. They effortlessly float on the surface of water (lotus leshy)
a thick sticky sap from bark-like flesh making climbing easier (pine leshy).
a body that is made from hard roots that firmly attach to the ground (root aka. groot).
a body that is made from woven seaweed and they are comfortable underwater (seaweed leshy).
a body that is made of woven vines and their climbing ability is unmatched (vine leshy).

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Leshies are immortal nature spirits placed in small plant bodies, seeking to experience the world.

traits.name: Plant Nourishment
traits.description: You gain nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match your body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with your roots, or scavenging decaying matter. You typically do not need to pay for food. If you normally rely on photosynthesis and go without sunlight for 1 week, you begin to starve. You can derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (or 40 sp).

name: Orc - Common
languages: Common, Orcish, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Goblin, Jotun, Petran, Sakvroth.

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Orcs are proud, strong people with hardened physiques who value physical might and glory in combat.

name: Kholo (gnoll) - Uncommon
languages: Common, Orcish, Additional languages equal to your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from Goblin, Jotun, Petran, Sakvroth.

traits.name: tl;dr
traits.description: Kholos are hyena-headed humanoids who embrace practicality and pragmatism.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your sharp teeth and powerful jaws are fearsome weapons. You have a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group.
